Hymn 251: Behold! A Royal Army
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major

This is hymn number 251 titled "Behold! A Royal Army" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Adam Geibel and the lyrics were written by Fanny J. Crosby.
